title: 2026 franchise kernel inspection (rules unavailable)

Host companions bind the exact SAVEGAME.DAT digest and must be explicitly retained. Native saving cannot persist this companion.
Host rules accept 53 active, 12 PS/65 combined on legacy saves or 16/eligible 17 PS/70 combined on migrated arenas. The dormant native selector still has its 65-entry input ABI. Five IR slots remain.
--assess-save accepts raw 720044/724140-byte native saves with an optional validated 128-byte MyCareer footer. It performs no writes and does not authenticate EXTRA.
Player byte +0x53 bits 0-5 already belong to stars, abilities and Guardian caps. Unassigned bits 6-7 are not an allocated ledger. Rules use the supplied frozen R1-R5 memo.
